TestClusterReplacement::test_rolling_clu.description: 3-node single-DC cluster, RF=1, 10000 rows written at CL=ALL. Every original node is replaced one by one by bootstrapping a new node then decommissioning the old one (cleanup on remaining nodes after each step). Finally all rows are read at CL=ONE from the newest node. Guards that rolling 'field' replacement (add+decommission) with RF=1 loses no data.
